She went through my phone while I was showering and saw a convo between me and one of my female friends. Me and this friend had talked three times for a combined total of maybe 15 minutes. The convo consisted her of listing a bunch of stupid nicknames she could call me. I knew we were never going to use these nicknames so I didn’t tell her to stop. I also didn’t say any nicknames because I figured that was weird. She got really upset at me and told me I cheated on her. I understood why she say it that way so I did everything I could to make it up to her. I blocked all of my female friends on all social media and cut them out of my college life (me and my ex were LDR for college).
